title: SE implementation scratchpad - Crosswave Trust
content:
Goal: capture quick implementation notes + action items for Crosswave Trust deployment (Dedicated + optional Private VPC).

Context:
- Customer: Crosswave Trust (regional bank) needs low-latency chat + document ingestion for customer support workflows.
- Compliance: data-at-rest encryption via customer KMS, SAML SSO, audit logs retention 1 year.
- Target: initial pilot for 10k messages/day, burst to 50k/day.

Immediate action items:
1) Network & infra (owner: Samir)
   - Confirm VPC peering topology with Crosswave network team (open question: allow public egress or full private).
   - Ensure subnets in us-east-1 with private routes to KMS and logging endpoints.
   - Ports: allow 443 outbound to Redwood control plane; 10250 for node agent (if on-prem optional).
   - Follow-up: request firewall rules by 2026-03-05.

2) Security & identity (owner: Alicia)
   - SAML metadata exchange: get IdP metadata + test SP assertion.
   - KMS: verify key policy allows Redwood service principal; ask for key ARN.
   - Audit: enable delivery of audit logs to customer's CloudWatch/S3.

3) Model & serving config (owner: Priya)
   - Recommend starting model: open-mpt-12B-quant-v2 (verified latency profile).
   - Dedicated pool: 4x A10G equivalent for pilot (estimate qps 40-60 depending on batch).
   - Batching: target max_batch_tokens=2048, max_batch_size=8; initial concurrency=4.
   - KV cache: enable prefix caching for support prompts (reuse common system messages).

4) Deployment plan / rollouts (owner: Jordan)
   - Canary: 5% traffic for 24h, monitor latency and token cost.
   - Fallback: route to hosted small-model (redwood-small-2) if Dedicated capacity exhausted.

Open questions / risks:
- Quantization tradeoffs: need to run eval on customer prompts to confirm quality drop. (Task: run 100 prompt eval by 2026-03-08).
- Network latency guarantee: Crosswave expects <120ms p50 for short chat messages; need to validate from their endpoints to us-east-1.
- SLA negotiation: Dedicated vs Private pricing delta; finance needs estimate by next week.

Helpful commands / notes:
- Assign pool: redwood infra-cli create-pool --name crosswave-pilot --gpu-type a10g --count 4 --region us-east-1
- Pin model: redwood api deployments create --model open-mpt-12B-quant-v2 --pool crosswave-pilot --policy canary:5%
- KMS test: aws kms encrypt --key-id <key-arn> --plaintext 'test' --profile crosswave

Deliverables / timeline:
- 2026-03-05: network firewall rules confirmed (Samir)
- 2026-03-08: eval results on 100 prompts (Priya)
- 2026-03-10: pilot pool up and canary started (Jordan)
- 2026-03-17: review with Crosswave + handoff to ops for production ramp

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep short list of fallback model ids handy.
- Ask eng-serving-runtime about a kernel tweak for 8-token warmup improvement.
- Slack threads: #se-crosswave, link to thread: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/CS12345

Reference links (internal):
- Confluence playbook: /display/SE/Crosswave+Implementation+Playbook
- JIRA tickets: SE-6124 (implementation), INF-2219 (networking)

Done / completed items:
- Initial scoping call (2026-02-20) - notes uploaded to Confluence.
- NDA signed (2026-02-22).

——
Quick reminders: check with support on log retention costs; estimate egress for embedding sync job.
